restoration_note: This teaching describes the Living Spirit's threefold ordering of the natural mind through the cosmic 'prow' (ⲡⲣⲓⲣⲁⲥ) — the lower vessel into which the self's revolving sphere is cast and bound. The fills cluster: (1) editor-confirmed mid-word completions of standard Lycopolitan vocabulary (ⲫⲁⲗⲁⲥⲥⲁ, ⲡⲱⲛϩ, ⲡⲣⲓⲣⲁⲥ, ⲡⲕⲁϩ, ⲡⲧⲏⲩ, ⲡⲕⲱⲧⲉ, etc.) which are uniformly high confidence; (2) the chronological-seal enumeration moments→hours→days→months→years→characters of stars, well-anchored by formula; (3) the final-clause fill ⲙ̄ⲧⲁⲛ ('rest') as the structurally apt close paired with ⲙⲟⲩϩ ('fullness') and ⲧⲱϥ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲕⲓⲙ ('without his moving'), matching the lexicon's spiritual register; (4) genuinely unrestorable spans at the opening ({0}, {1}), the textual marker {5}, the painter/architect comparison ({14}-{15}), and the broken final segment ({44}, {46}). The teaching's spiritual logic — that the self's vessel is permitted to form so that it may then winnow itself, peg the wheel of self-love, and serve as the all-receiving still-place where influx gathers — constrained the moderate-confidence fills (ⲡⲕⲱⲧⲉ, ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ, ⲡⲕⲁⲣⲁⲝ, ⲙ̄ⲧⲁⲛ) without forcing speculative completions where character counts and grammar permit several readings.
